caveats: 863 is the number of chunk-level extracted records, not printed occurrences.
The 1944 last year is a retrospective article, not evidence that Trimen (d. 1896) was active.
The link to Wikidata was made by rules (name, dates, occupation); the link to the Colonial Office List by surname, given names, career overlap and a Ceylon posting.

Page 272 (n289) reads 'confirmed by Mr. Ledger himself, who certainly ought to be the best authority as to what is and what is not C. Ledgeriana'. The OCR rendered this as 'Mr. L. J. L. Trimen'.
